scientific_integrity: The infinite-domain reduction to c<=5032 is proved symbolically. The computation is an exact exhaustive check only after that cutoff, and it checks all integer seventh powers, a stronger finite condition than prime seventh powers.
scientific_limitations: The result settles only the exponent-7 case of the open pristine-number question for numbers of the form 2^c q^d. It does not settle odd exponents d>=9. Literature non-detection cannot exclude an unindexed prior observation.
title: No pristine number has the form \(2^c q^7\)
